name: maybe_Os_SetThreadPriorityMode

name: maybe_Gfx_IsDisplayStateReady

evidence: Body is `func_0010CC10() == 1`; sibling Gfx_ neighbours and the frame-dispatch caller fix the subsystem, but 0x0010CC10 is unnamed so 'ready' is only plausible.

name: maybe_Gfx_IsDisplayStateActive

evidence: Callers Mem_InitializeMainHeap and Engine_DispatchFrameCallbacks; callees maybe_Gfx_ResetStateBlock and maybe_Gfx_InitInterrupts; exact state meaning unknown.

name: maybe_Gfx_HandleVBlank

name: maybe_Gfx_ConvertTextureBlock

evidence: 'HTP' type tag at 0x00780EAC and Gfx_IpcCmd803 callee; only caller Fs_Initialize does not confirm convert vs size.

name: maybe_Gfx_InitFrameBuffers

summary: One-shot display-buffer setup guarded by 0x007AEA70: allocates size bytes, copies the 0x2b0-byte command block into the set and derives five sub-buffer pointers at 0, 0xa8, 0x108, 0x158 and 0x238.
evidence: Only caller maybe_Os_ShutdownSyncObject; callee Gfx_ShutdownChannelLocked; body moves Os_SendIpcQuery6 results and the 0x2b0 block, framebuffer reading rests on the paired teardown.

name: maybe_Snd_SetSuspendState

name: maybe_Queue_SubmitEntry
summary: Appends a buffer entry to the owner's submission chain, publishes it with a memory barrier, pushes to the OS queue or ring buffer, then assigns and returns the next sequence number.
